name: How does GEO differ from traditional SEO for financial advisors?

mainEntity.name: How does GEO differ from traditional SEO for financial advisors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional SEO focuses on optimizing websites for keyword rankings in search engine results. GEO, while including traditional SEO elements, expands to optimize for generative AI responses and conversational search. It involves tailoring content to be digestible and accurate for AI models that synthesize information to answer user queries directly. This means optimizing for direct answers, structured data, and authoritative content that AI systems can confidently cite or use.
acceptedAnswer.description: GEO builds on traditional SEO by optimizing for AI-driven search responses and conversational interfaces, not just keyword rankings.
